# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` first, then `CODEX.md` and only the skill or documentation
sources relevant to the current task. Preserve unrelated working-tree changes,
use the repository's current vocabulary, and run the validation commands named
in `AGENTS.md` after harness or documentation edits.

When drafting or updating a pull request description, use
`.github/pull_request_template.md` as the canonical structure. Keep the
`Changes`, `Related tasks and lanes`, and `Task cleanup` sections. Report each
task's relationship and current status with evidence or a next gate. Keep task
completion distinct from cleanup status, and do not claim validation, cleanup,
or registry removal that did not occur.
